title: PART SATSUMA TEA SET - AS IS
reason: Fine Meiji-style Satsuma tea set with gilt bamboo and sparrow painting and a gold-on-black two-character signature cartouche (appears 光山, read from photos), 10 pieces, sold as is; a comparable Satsuma set made GBP 950 at Gorringes in 2022.
findings: Fine Japanese Satsuma-type earthenware tea set, probably Meiji export (about 1880-1910), with crisp painting of bamboo groves and flying sparrows, raised gold gilt on the foliage and gilt rims; cream crackled glaze with pink-tinged cup interiors. Pieces seen: teapot (gilt ball finial), covered sugar bowl (orange-red ball finial, two small loop handles), covered milk jug (orange-red ball finial), 3 cups with 3 saucers, and 1 extra saucer or side plate on a stand (10 pieces). The title mentions no maker. Photos 4 and 5 show a rectangular gold-on-black cartouche on the cup base with two characters that appear to read 光山 (Kozan); this is read from the photos only, and the Kozan name was used by several Meiji workshops, so the maker is not confirmed. Rough comparable seen: Gorringes (Lewes) sale of 28 June 2022, lot 133, Kinkozan Meiji Satsuma tea wares (teapot, sugar pot, milk jug, four cups and saucers), estimate GBP 300 to 500, sold for GBP 950, with one chipped cup and a riveted sugar lid (https://auction.gorringes.co.uk/auction-lot-detail/LJUNE22/133, fetched 19/10/2026). That set had different decoration and four-character Kinkozan style marks, so it is only a guide.
condition: Sold as is. Visible: a small rim chip on one saucer at about 9 o'clock (photo 4); light gilt wear on some rims and handle tips; the teapot spout tip looks intact with a gilt rim. No cracks seen on the visible surfaces, but hairlines, cup interiors, lid fit and the undersides of the other pieces are not shown. Incomplete set (one cup short of the saucers).
rescore_note: Good looking Meiji export Satsuma tea ware: fine bamboo and sparrow painting, raised gilt, gold-on-black cartouche that appears to read Kozan (maker unconfirmed); 10 pieces, a cup short, small saucer chip, sold as is. Loose guide only: Gorringes 28/6/2022 lot 133 Kinkozan tea wares (different decoration, chipped cup, riveted lid) sold GBP 950, https://auction.gorringes.co.uk/auction-lot-detail/LJUNE22/133, seen 19/10/2026. This set sits lower, in the $200-500 band.
